name: due-work-harness
description: Prove that important Python background work survives crashes, retries, lost messages, and uncertain external calls.

interface.longDescription: Find and prove failure paths in Python workflows where a crash, lost message, retry, stale worker, or uncertain external call could lose or repeat an order, payment, receipt, notification, data import, or other owed effect. Guides repository analysis and due-work-harness pytest contracts across supported integrations. Running proofs requires a coding environment with the target repository and test services.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this order flow can lose a payment or receipt after a crash.
Prove this queue worker survives retries, lost replies, and stale owners.
Find work that may disappear between a database commit and job dispatch.
